description: Synthetic Category contract case (RC-84 near-boundary positive, from Run 45103217994: Nagoya Arahata/Shin-Mizuhashi): smoke on a station platform stops two lines.

candidates.title: Smoke on a station platform halts two subway lines
candidates.search_snippet: Smoke on a station platform halts two subway lines.
candidates.source_content: Smoke rose on the platform of a subway station on Thursday morning, and the operator stopped trains on two lines for about an hour. About 6,700 passengers were affected. The operator is investigating the source of the smoke on the platform.
